s: Dine maboy velechi ubo m"d seipim: kebar nitbaer besimman shm"h shemmin hattora kol maqom sheyyesh lo g' mechitztzot uparutz bemilluo beruach rebiit hu reshut hayyachid gemura im parutz lekarmelit, sheen rabbim boqeim sham. Veap im parutz lirshut harabbim, sheddino kekarmelit, hare muttar letaltel bekarmelit min hattora kemo birshut hayyachid. Ella shechakamim aseru hattiltul bo, ben shepparutz lirshut harabbim ben shepparutz lekarmelit, mippene sheddomeh qetzat lirshut harabbim, kevan shepparutz bemilluo. Lepikak hittiru kesheasa ezeh tiqqun bimqom happirtza, apillu tiqqun sheeno moil min hattora, kegon lehanniach qora rechaba tepach al petach hammaboy happatuach lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit, shebbeqora zo en omerim bah min hattora "pi tiqra yored vesotem", hoil veen berochbah d' tepachim en shem tiqra aleha, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"v. Veap al pi ken moelet bemaboy middibre soperim, hoil vegam issur hattiltul bo eno ella middibre soperim, mippene sheddomeh qetzat lirshut harabbim. Vekevan sheyyesh qora al pitcho, yesh bezeh hekker vezikkaron laroim, sheyyakkiru veyedeu shettaqqanat chakamim hi qora zo bemaboy zeh, velo yitchallep lahem birshut harabbim. Veken heqellu bemaboy lehattiro belechi sheobyo verochbo kol shehu vegobho y' tepachim, sheyyaamidennu bepetach hammaboy etzel echad mehakketalim, shellechi zeh niddon mishshum mechitztza gemura min hattora bekol maqom sheyyesh lo b' mechitztzot shelemot velechi zeh, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh[m]"h. Ella shechakamim aseru beb' mechitztzot velechi vehittiru beg' mechitztzot velechi:

Lo hittiru beg' mechitztzot velechi echad o qora rechaba tepach ella bemaboy, abal chatzer shehi perutza bemilluah beruach rebiit enah nitteret ella bepas rachab d' tepachim sheyyaamidennu betzad echad bemaqom happarutz. Veim yirtzeh letaqqena bishne tzedade happirtza — day bishne passin sherochban mashshehu, raq sheyyihyeh gobham y' tepachim. Vehu haddin im nishtayyer mikkotel rebiit atzmo banuy keshiur d' tepachim mitztzad echad, o im nishtayyer mishshene hatztzedadim tepach mikkan vetepach mikkan. Abal bepachot mittepach en kol kak hekker behammeshuyyar mehakkotel kemo bepas gamur shemmaamido leshem kak:

Velamma hechemiru bechatzer yoter mibbemaboy? Mippene shekkol shehu asuy yoter ledira uletashmishe hatznea tzarik mechitztzot yoter gemurot. Ulepikak hachatzerot sheddarkan shel baale battim lehishtammesh bahen yoter betashmishe hatznea veleekol bahen, tzerikot mechitztzotehen lihyot yoter gemurot, sheyyihyeh shem reshut hayyachid alehen, mehammeboot sheen mishtammeshin bahem betashmishe hatznea:

Vaapillu chatzer sheen bepirtzat milluah d' tepachim tzerika tiqqun zeh, ella im ken en bah g' tepachim, shekkol pachot mig' tepachim hu kesatum veen tzarik tiqqun kelal. Abal maboy sheen berochab pitcho d' tepachim, yesh mattirin, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veim yesh bappirtza yoter meeser ammot, apillu eno bemilluah ella nishtayyeru o heemid lo gippupin mikkan umikkan, vaapillu haggippupim yeterim al happirtza — tzarik letaqqenah betzurat petach kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"b, ben bechatzer ben bemaboy kemo sheyyitbaer:

Bakkol osin lechayayim, apillu mibbaale chayyim, ubilbad sheyyiqsherennu sham bachabalim lekotle hammaboy bitedot sheyyotzein min hakketalim, beinyan sheeno yakol lirbotz, kede shello yitmaet gobhan mi' tepachim vitaltelu bemaboy beissur al semak lechi zeh. Vaapillu adam haomed sham niddon mishshum lechi. Vehu sheqqesharo sham, im lo hodio sheheemido leshem lechi, shehare bevadday yelek lo — shello yaamod sham kol hayyom — vitaltelu bemaboy beissur. Abal im hodio shemmaamido leshem lechi, en chosheshin sheyyelek lo (ella sheaz tzarik lehaamido meereb shabbat, shehare lechi niddon mishshum mechitztza, veasur laasot mechitztza meadam beshabbat ella im ken shello ledato, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"b[)]:

Im yesh qetzat kotel beruach rebiit, oleh mishshum lechi, ubilbad sheyyehe bo rochab tepach mishshum hekker, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Vaapillu abanim hayyotzeim min hakkotel zo lemala mizzo pachot mig' tepachim, olin mishshum lechi im rochban tepach:

Lechi sheruach metzuya yakol lahanido, ap al pi sheenah yekola lehappilo — eno chashub mishshum lechi, shehallechi hu kimchitztza, vekol mechitztza sheruach metzuya menidatah enah mechitztza, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"b:
Im hirchiq hallechi min hakkotel g' tepachim, ben letok chalal rochab hammaboy ben lehalea letzad chutz — lo asa velo kelum. Abal pachot mig' tepachim kelabud hu:

Lechi — apillu shebarim veshibre shebarim medubbaqim kesherim bo, kol sheyyekolim laamod beruach metzuya. Velaken osim lechi missid (tichuach) tachuy bakkotel, sheal yede hakkotel hu rauy laamod. Ubilbad sheyyizzaher shello yitmacheh g' tepachim samuk laaretz, shellechi haggaboah g' tepachim min haaretz pasul, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veap shelleachar shennitmecha nishar sham marehu nikkar al pene hakkotel, en zeh moil kelum, ki tzarik sheyyehe hallechi qetzat dabar mammash veab qetzat bolet min hakkotel:

Lechi sheasao meatze ashera — kasher. Veap al pi shehallechi tzarik sheyyehe bo shiur, dehaynu gobah y' tepachim verochab veobi kol shehu, vekol dabar hatztzarik shiur en osin oto meatze ashera, mippene sheomedim lisrepa ukeillu nisrepu venaasu eper veniktat shiuram, mikkol maqom illu haya medabbeq ketitutam, dehaynu shehaya megabbel haeper — haya yakol laasot mimmennu gobah y' tepachim veobi mashshehu. Lepikak hu kasher:

Ben shennireh belitat hallechi laomedim betok hammaboy veenah niret laomedim chutz lammaboy, kegon sheheemid hallechi rochbo letzad orko shel maboy, velo mashak qetzeh rochbo qima kelappe chutz ella hishva chuddo hachitzon leobi kotel hammaboy, vedomeh kemi shemmosip al obi hakkotel veeno nireh mibbachutz kelechi, abal chuddo happenimi nireh laomedim sham bipnim, kezeh. Uben shenniret belitato laomedim bachutz velo laomedim bipnim, kegon shemmashak kol hallechi lachutz vechuddo happenimit niknas beobi hakkotel, veeno nireh mibbipnim kelechi ella domeh kemosipo al orek hakkotel, abal mibbechutz nikkar sheeno mikkotel hammaboy shehare nimshak lehalea meobi hakkotel, kezeh — kasher. Veyesh omerim shehallechi hannireh mibbachutz velo mibbipnim eno kasher ella im ken nireh laomedim bachutz neged chalal hammaboy besamuk lo, kegon shehallechi shemmeshako lachutz vechuddo happenimi niknas beobi hakkotel lo heemido lispat obi shel tzad hammaboy, beinyan shellehaomedim bipnim nireh kemosip al orek hakkotel, sheaz gam lehaomedim bachutz neged chalal hammaboy besamuk lo nireh lahem ken, ella heemido lispat obi shel tzad achore hammaboy, kezeh (veken iqqar):

Higbiho mehaaretz g' tepachim — pasul, shehallechi hu kimchitztza, umechitztza haggaboah g' tepachim min haaretz enah mechitztza, mippene shehaggedayim yekolim libqoa tachteha. Veim higbiho pachot mishshelosha, ap al pi sheen bo ella z' umashshehu — kasher, lepi shekkol labud roin oto kemale:

Apillu lo heemido sham leshem lechi, ella shennizdammen lo sham meelayv — kasher, shehallechi hu mishshum mechitztza, umechitztza haomedet meeleha — keshera, ubilbad sheyyismeku alayv meereb shabbat. Abal lo sameku alayv meereb shabbat, kegon shehaya sham lechi acher venapal beshabbat, ubaim akshav lismok al zeh — eno moil. Abal lo haya sham lechi acher meereb shabbat, ap al pi shello sameku al zeh beperush — hare zeh keillu sameku alayv min hassetam. Abal im beperush lo sameku alayv, kegon shello haya sham lechi acher velo tiltelu beshabbat sheobra al yede lechi zeh — eno moil leshabbat habbaa ad sheyyismeku alayv meereb shabbat beperush:

Lechi haomed meelayv ubolet d' ammot letok hammaboy berochab, ap al pi shessameku alayv meereb shabbat, eno niddon mishshum lechi, mippene shed' ammot hu shiur maboy veen kan hekker shehu lechi. Veap al pi shehallechi kimchitztza gemura, mikkol maqom tzarik sheyyehe bo gam ken hekker qetzat, vetzarik lechi acher lehattir maboy zeh, veyaamidennu beruach shekkeneged lechi zeh. Veim yirtzeh lehaamido etzlo, yaasennu meat ab o daq mimmennu, kede sheyyehe nikkar shehu mishshum lechi velo yihyeh kemosip al harishon. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemaboy harachab yoter mech' ammot. Abal maboy sheeno rachab ella ch' ammot, en tzarik lechi acher lehattiro ap al pi shello sameku alayv meereb shabbat, ella nittar beomed keparutz, dehaynu lechi haomed meelayv sheyyesh bo d' ammot kemo sheyyesh behapparutz shemmimmennu lekkotel shekkenegdo, veomed keparutz mattir beruach rebiit shel maboy kemo shemmattir bed' ruchot shel chatzer, kemo shennitbaer basimman shs"b. Vekol zeh belechi haomed meelayv. Abal im heemido leshem lechi, apillu yesh bo yoter mid' ammot niddon mishshum lechi, mippene sheyyesh lo qol shettiqqenuhu lechi lemaboy zeh, veyesh bo hekker ap sherachab harbeh:

Lechi hammoshek berochbo im orek dopno shel maboy, sheheemid chuddo keneged obi hakkotel mibbachutz, sheen chuddo mekasseh et kol obi hakkotel, ella miqtzat obyo shel tzad hechalal hammaboy lepi sebara harishona shennitbaer lemala (seip ya), o miqtzat obyo shel tzad achore hammaboy lepi sebara haacharona shennitbaer sham, dehaynu sheen hallechi nireh venikkar ella lehaomedim bachutz, abal lehaomedim bipnim nireh hu keillu hu mikkotel hammaboy lepi sebara harishona, o shennireh ken laomedim achore hammaboy lepi sebara haacharona — im yesh berochab lechi zeh d' ammot, naasa kemaboy veyatza mittorat lechi, ap al pi shehuamad leshem lechi pachot mid' ammot niddon mishshum lechi, veen mishtammeshin ella ad chuddo happenimi, shehare mishsham veelak en kenegdo kotel betzad hashsheni:

(Ap al pi shehallechi tzarik sheyyehe bo hekker, mikkol maqom iqqaro mishshum mechitztza veen tzarik ella qetzat hekker, velaken moil keshehu betok g' tepachim lekotel hammaboy, apillu mibbachutz. Abal) qora hammatteret bemaboy (en hetterah ella mishshum hekker, lepikak) tzarik sheyyannichenna al kotle hammaboy. Abal im naatz b' yetedot bekotle hammaboy bachutz, apillu besamuk lo mammash, vehinniach haqqora alehen — pesula:

Vetzarik sheyyannichenna kede lehattir hammaboy. Abal im lo hunnecha sham bishbil kak, apillu sameku aleha meereb shabbat — pesula. Veeno domeh lelechi, shehallechi hu mishshum mechitztza, abal haqqora hu mishshum hekker bilbad, veim lo hunnecha bishbil kak en bah hekker kol kak:
Qora zo sheameru — tzerika shiur. Ulepikak im asaah meatze ashera, pesula, shekkevan shellisrepa omedet, hare hi keillu kebar nisrepa veniktat shiurah:

Shiur haqqora — kede leqabbel qeruy shel arichim. Veariach hu chatzi lebena shel g' tepachim al g' tepachim, nimtza orek ariach g' tepachim verochbo tepach umechetza. Dayyah laqqora shettehe rechaba tepach, sheaz hi reuya leqabbel ariach lerochbo tepach, vachatzi tepach hannishar yukal lechabber keetzba mimmennu betit mikkan ukeetzba mimmennu betit mikkan. Veobi haqqora day bekol shehu, raq shettehe chazaqa leqabbel arichim shokebim aleha bekol orkah, keshiur rochab petach hammaboy, mudbaqim sham betit kepi mah shetztzarik lahem. Sheim lo ken lo yihyeh bah hekker, ki seburim bene reshut harabbim shellepi shaa nittena sham. Abal keshehi beria veaba leqabbel binyan kezeh, nikkar umepursam lakkol shelliqbiut hunnecha sham. Mikkol maqom en tzarik shettehe reuya leqabbel arichim shokebim bekol orkah mammash, ella kepachot meamma mishshiur rochab petach hammaboy. Kegon im rochbo eser ammot, dayyah im teqabbel arichim beorek t' ammot ub' mashshehuyin, shehen y"ch arichim leorkan, lepi sheqqorat t' ammot ub' mashshehuyin matteret bemaboy eser ammot middin labud, dehaynu shello taggia pachot mig' tepachim lekotel zeh upachot mig' tepachim lekotel zeh, kemo sheyyitbaer. Veim haqqora rechaba d' tepachim, enah tzerika lihyot chazaqa leqabbel arichim:

Maamide haqqora — dehaynu im hi nismeket al haytedot hayyotzeim min hakkotel letok rochab hammaboy veen berochban tepach, sheim lo ken hare hen atzman torat qora alehen, veen beorkan g' tepachim, sheim lo ken en haqqora shealehen matteret hammaboy, kemo sheyyitbaer — yesh omerim shemmaamidim ellu tzerikin sheyyihyu chazaqim kede leqabbel haqqora im haarichim, veyesh omerim sheenan tzerikim lihyot chazaqim ella kede leqabbel haqqora bilbaddah, shehare en notenim aleha kelal arichim, ubaqqora bilbaddah hu shetztzarik qebiut, kede shettehe hekker meulleh, abal maamideha — en hekker taluy bahem kelal (uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim halek achar hammeqel):
Hayeta haqqora agulla — tzarik sheyyihyeh beheqqepah g' tepachim, sheaz yesh bah rochab tepach:

Hayeta aqumma veaqmimutah nota lechutz lammaboy, sheshsham en meqom hannachat qora, kemo shennitbaer lemala, o shennota lematta mi' tepachim o lemala mik' amma, sheshsham gam ken en meqom hannachat qora, kemo sheyyitbaer — roin: kol sheillu yinnatel haaqmumit veen ben zeh lezeh g' tepachim — keshera mishshum labud, veim lav — pesula:

Hayeta yotzet mikkotel zeh veenah maggaat lakkotel shekkenegdah, o apillu enah maggaat lishnehem, kegon shehinnicham al ammudim samuk lakketalim pachot mig' tepachim, veken b' qorot achat yotzea mikkotel zeh veachat yotzea mikkotel zeh upageu zo bezo beemtza hammaboy, veen benehem g' tepachim — keshera, yesh benehen g' tepachim — pesula:

Hinniach b' qorot zo etzel zo, lo bezo rochab tepach velo bezo rochab tepach, im yesh bishtehen rochab tepach veen ben zo lezo shelosha tepachim — en tzarik lehabi qora acheret. Vaapillu hayeta achat lemala veachat lematta — roin et haelyona keillu hi lematta veet hattachtona keillu hi lemala, ubilbad shello tehe haelyona lemala meesrim amma velo hattachtona lematta measara tepachim min haaretz, velo yihyeh benehen g' tepachim lo begobah velo bemeshek, dehaynu kesheroin otan sheyyorda zo veolta zo ad shennaasu zo betzad zo, lo yihyeh mizzo lezo g' tepachim. Abal yesh benehem g' tepachim begobah — en roin otan keillu yorda zo veolta zo, lepi sheen roin ken ella bedabar sheyyesh bo rochab tepach, kemo sheyyitbaer simman trl"a. Mah sheen ken pachot mig' tepachim kelabud hu. Yesh omerim sheapillu hen zo betzad zo ubeshaveh, enan mitztorpin lerochab tepach ella im ken hen qerobot zo lezo betok tepach, sheap shekkol pachot mig' tepachim kelabud hu, mikkol maqom hare enan reuyot leqabbel ariach lerochbo ella im ken hen betok tepach zo lezo, sheaz yakol lehanniach rochab haariach al shettehen keetzba mimmennu al zo ukeetzba mimmennu al zo vetepach baemtza. Veim hen zo lemala mizzo — pesulot bekol inyan, kevan sheenan reuyot leqabbel ariach, veen kan hekker kelal shelliqbiut hunnechu sham. Veyesh lehachamir kedibrehem:

Peras al haqqora machatzelet, veenah maggaat ad haqqarqa ella hi gaboah g' tepachim — pesula, shehare kissa et haqqora veenah niret, ubotla mihyot qora kevan sheen bah hekker laroim. Vehammachatzelet enah kimchitztza ap im chibberah sham beinyan sheen haruach menidah, kevan sheggaboah g' tepachim min haaretz. Abal im hinniach haqqora aba beyoter, sheyyesh beobyah y' tepachim milmala lematta — lo botla mittorat qora, ap al pi sheggobah atzmah hu keshiur gobah mechitztza shehu y' tepachim, veen omerim shehi kimchitztza gaboah min haaretz shelosha. Raq shettehe kullah lemala mi' tepachim min haaretz, abal qora shemmiqtzatah betok asara — pesula, shekkevan shehechalal shettachtayv en bo asara, en shem maboy alayv, vehaqqora tzerika lihyot al gabbe maboy:

Naatz b' yetedot aqummot al kotle hammaboy, veaqmimutam nota letok hammaboy, lihyotan senip lehaarik haqqora mib' tziddeha keshettinnaten alehen, vehen atzman enan reuyot leheksher qora, sheen bahen rochab tepach — im en bintiyyat aqmimutan g' tepachim, sheyyesh lomar labud merashe haqqora velakketalim, veen begobhan shel yetedot mimmaal lakketalim g' tepachim — keshera, sheanu roim keillu hi munnachat al kotle hammaboy. Abal im yesh bintiyyatan g', o sheyyesh begobhan g' — en roin otah keillu hi al hakketalim. Ap al pi shekkol dabar sheyyesh bo rochab tepach omerim bo sheanu roim keillu yarad lematta apillu beyoter mig' tepachim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman trl"a, mikkol maqom kan beqora, shetztzarik lihyot al gabbe hammaboy mammash, en omerim ken ella bepachot mig' tepachim shehu kelabud:

Maboy harachab bepitcho yoter meeser ammot, eno nittar belechi veqora ella betzurat petach. Veken maboy sheen ketalayv gebohim y' tepachim (ap al pi shehu reshut hayyachid al yede kotle habbattim vehachatzerot), en shem maboy alayv veeno nittar belechi veqora (ella betzurat petach). Veken maboy sheen beorko d' ammot en shem maboy alayv, ella dino kechatzer, sheenah nitteret belechi veqora ella bepas d' o beb' passin shel b' mashshehuyin. Veellu y' tepachim shel gobah ved' ammot shel orek tzerikin lihyot meruvvachot velo metzumtzamot. Vehaeser ammot shel rochab modedim otan metzumtzamot — hakkol lehachamir. Veshiur haodep shel hammeruvvachot al hammetzumtzamot hu chatzi etzba laamma:

Maboy sheyyesh begobah chalalo yoter meesrim amma metzumtzamot — eno nittar beqora, shehaqqora hi mishshum hekker, ubeyoter mik' amma en bah hekker, mippene sheen haayin sholetet sham. Abal nittar hu belechi. Veim rotzeh lehakshiro beqora — tzarik sheyyaaseh bah tziyyur vekiyyur, sheal yede ken hakkol mistakkelim bah. Abal im gobah chalalah eno ella k' metzumtzamot, ap al pi shehaqqora hi lemala meesrim — keshera:

Maboy haggaboah yoter mk', ubana binyan tachat haqqora beqarqait hammaboy lemaet chalalo sham — day bebinyan rachab tepach kerochab haqqora. Vehu haddin im yitten sham apar berochab tepach, raq shetztzarik lizzaher keshennidras baraglayim, shello yitmaet shiur hatztzarik lemaet gobah chalal hammaboy. Abal maboy sheeno gaboah y' tepachim, vechoqeq bo lehashlimo — tzarik lachoq d' ammot letok orek hammaboy al pene kol rochbo, shekkevan sheen lo mechitztzot asara veen shem maboy alayv kelal, uba laasot lo mechitztzot, tzarik laasotan keshiur orek maboy, shehu d' ammot. Mah sheen ken begaboah lemala mik', sheshshem maboy alayv ella shetztzarik lemaato mishshum hekker bilbad — day sheyyitmaet tachat haqqora bilbad, shebbemiut zeh yihyeh bah hekker keshenniknasim tachteha lemaboy:

En maboy nittar belechi veqora ad sheyyihyu petuchim letoko shette chatzerot, ulekol chatzer shene battim. Abal pachot mikken dino kechatzer, sheenah nitteret ella bepas d' o beb' passin shel b' mashshehuyin, lepi shekkol sheddiyyurin muatim hem, mishtammeshim bo yoter betashmishe hatznea, sheenan boshim kol kak leekol bo o shear tashmishe hatznea. Vekol shemmishtammeshin bo yoter, tzerikin mechitztzotayv lihyotan yoter gemurot, kemo shennitbaer lemala. Vaapillu im harbeh battim belo chatzerot petuchim letoko, vegam harbeh chatzerot shebbayit echad bekol chatzer — en kol zeh moil kelum, ad sheyyihyu b' chatzerot sheyyesh bahen b' battim petuchim letoko, shello ratzu chakamim latet dibrehem leshiurim, lechalleq ben b' chatzerot bilbad, sheenan moilot ella im ken b' battim bekol achat mehen, uben yoter mib' chatzerot, sheyyoilu bebayit echad bekol chatzer. Vaapillu im habbattim atzman petuchim lammaboy. Velaken kol meboot shellanu yesh lahem din chatzer, kemo sheyyitbaer. Umaboy sheppetuchim letoko b' chatzerot sheppetuchim lahem b' battim, tzarik shello yihyeh bekol petach meellu pachot merochab d' tepachim, sheaz en alayv shem petach kelal. Vegam tzarik sheyyihyu diyyurim okelim bekol bayit, shemmeqom happat gorem velo meqom lina. Vaapillu haya habbayit haechad leab vehashsheni leben, ap al pi shehabben meqabbel peras mishshulchan abiv veokel babbayit shello — hare hem niddonim kishnayim, venittar hammaboy belechi o qora. Veap al pi shelleinyan erube chatzerot hem keechad veenam oserim zeh al zeh, mikkol maqom kevan sheeruban hu middibre soperim, holekin bahen kan vekan lehaqel. Veken maboy shetztziddo echad chatzer shel nokri vetziddo echad shel yisrael nittar belechi veqora. Veap al pi sheddirat hannokri lo shemah dira lehachamir veleesor al hayyisrael, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shp"b, mikkol maqom lehaqel shemah dira:

Yesh omerim sheshte chatzerot ellu sheal yadan nittar hammaboy belechi veqora tzarik shello tihyena petuchot zo lezo, sheaz enan yekolot leareb yachad. Abal im hen petuchot zo lezo, kevan shehen yekolot leareb yachad uletaltel mizzo lezo shello bederek hammaboy, hare hen kechatzer achat. Vehu haddin habbattim shebbechatzer im hem petuchim zeh lezeh, sheyyekolim leareb yachad uletaltel mizzeh lezeh shello bederek hechatzer, hare hem kebayit echad, veen hammaboy nittar al yadan belechi veqora. Veyesh mattirin, veken iqqar:

En hammaboy nittar belechi veqora ella im ken orko yater al rochbo apillu mashshehu. Abal im orko kerochbo o rochbo yoter al orko — en shem maboy alayv, vedino kechatzer sheenah nitteret ella bepas d' o beb' passin shel b' mashshehuyin. Vechatzer sheorkah yater al rochbah apillu mashshehu — dinah kemaboy venitteret belechi o qora, veap al pi sheen chatzerot ubattim petuchin letokah, shello hitzriku ken ella bemaboy shehu patuach veqarob lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit, abal lo bechatzer shehi rechoqa mereshut harabbim o hakkarmelit, shehi petucha lemaboy vehammaboy patuach lahen. Ulepikak kol meboot shellanu, sheyyesh lahen din chatzerot hoil veen chatzerot shel b' battim petuchim letokam, ap al pi sheorkam yater al rochbam — enam nittarim belechi o qora, hoil vehen petuchim lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit, ella tzerikim pas d' o b' passin mashshehuyin im enam rechabim meeser ammot. Vekol shekken beir hammuqqepet choma, sheyyesh lehair din chatzer, vetzarik letaqqen hammeboot shebben yisrael lenokrim kedin habba lachaloq chatzer achat leb' reshuyyot, shello teesor reshut zo al zo belo erub — shello day belechi veqora ap im orkah yoter al rochbah, shehare apillu lechi veqora shebbemaboy gamur en moilin leinyan shello yaasru diyyurin shemmitztzad zeh shel hallechi al diyyurin shemmitztzad hab' im hallechi hu beemtza hammaboy veyesh gam ken lechi acher bepitcho, kemo sheyyitbaer. Umeboot harechabot yoter meeser — en passin moilin bahem, kemo shennitbaer lemala gabbe chatzer, ella tzarik letaqqenam betzurat petach. Vehamminhag happashut bimdinot ellu letaqqen kol hammeboot al yede chebel haqqashur lerochbo shel maboy miggag legag. Vechebel zeh eno mishshum qora, shehare en bo rochab tepach, ella hu mishshum tzurat petach, sheddayyah apillu begemi, kemo shennitbaer besimman shs"b. Veap sheen tzarik tzurat petach bepachot meeser, ap al pi ken nahagu betzurat petach, kede lehattir gam bimboot hammepullashim shetztzerikim tzurat petach, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"d. Veal ken tzarik lizzaher lehaamid b' qanim gebohim y' tepachim mekuvvanim mammash tachat hachebel, vezeh moil bekol maqom shetztzurat petach moelet. Veap al pi sheyyesh avir harbeh ben qanim lachebel, en bekak kelum kol shehem mekuvvanim tachtayv, kemo shennitbaer sham. Veyesh mi sheomer shetztzarik shello yihyeh benehem ella hepseq avir bilbad, abal im haqqanim omedim tachat haggag vehachebel qashur al gabbe haggag — en zo tzurat petach, shekkol tzurat petach darko lihyot hammashqop al hammezuzot beli hepseq dabar acher benetayim. Lepikak tzarik sheyyiptach neqeb gadol baggag lemala mehaqqanim, beinyan sheyyihyu mekuvvanim tachat hachebel beli hepseq dabar acher benetayim:

Abal kesheen qanim tachat hachebel, en kotle hammaboy nechshabim bimqom qanim lihyot tzurat petach, sheim lo ken, lamma hitzriku qora rechaba tepach? Halo beqaneh kol shehu sheal gabbe kotle hammaboy yesh tzurat petach. Umikkol maqom im yesh ammud bolet bakkotel o sheyyotzeim mimmennu chippupim pachot pachot mig' tepachim ad pachot mig' tepachim samuk laaretz, yesh lismok alehem (meereb shabbat) leshem qanim shel tzurat petach, ubilbad sheyyihyu megullim lemala tachat hachebel ledibre hammatzrikin ken:

Maboy shettoko rachab harbeh umitqatztzer veholek ad sheen bepitcho g' tepachim, eno tzarik tiqqun kelal, mippene shehu kesatum mittorat labud. Veyesh omerim shekkol sheen bepitcho d' tepachim, shehu shiur maqom, eno tzarik shum tiqqun kelal. Uleinyan halaka, bedibre soperim hallek achar hammeqel:

Maboy happatuach lirshut harabbim o lekarmelit umetuqqan sham belechi o qora, uberosho — dehaynu beruach shekkeneged happetach — yesh sham mechitztza mehachatzerot happetuchot letoko, ubetziddo haechad yesh mechitztza meashpa haggaboah y' tepachim, ubetziddo hab' yesh mechitztza mehayyam sheomqo y' tepachim samuk lispato mitlaqqet mittok d' ammot — hare zeh muttar, ubilbad shettehe ashpa shel rabbim sheenah asuya lehitpannot. Abal beashpa shel yachid, chosheshin shemma yepanneh ashpato vitaltelu bammaboy kemittechilla. Veyesh omerim shehayyam eno oleh mishshum mechitztza lemaboy, gezera shemma yaaleh hayyam sirton, shekken derek hayyam shemmitqatztzer venaaseh qarqa umaaleh sham chol vaabanim ubotla mechitztzato, shennitmaet shippuo sham veeno mitlaqqet y' tepachim mittok d' ammot, vitaltelu bammaboy kemittechilla. Veken iqqar. Abal bishar neharot en chosheshin sheyyaalu sirton, ella im ken otan neharot sheddarkan lehityabbesh baqqayitz ulehaalot sham chol vaabanim. Veim niqrash hannahar veniglad bimot hachorep — botla mechitztzato, veasur letaltel bammaboy kol yeme qerishato. Veyesh mi sheoser kol hashshana mishshum shemma yabou letaltel gam bachorep, kemo sheaseru bayyam kol hashshana mechashash shemma yetaltelu kesheyyaaleh hayyam sirton, veken banneharot sheddarkan bekak baqqayitz. Vetob lachush lidbarayv. Vekol zeh kesheen midron bannahar ella bimqom hammayim bilbad. Abal im yesh al sepato bayyabbasha midron hammitlaqqet asara mittok d' ammot, hare zeh nechshab limchitztza bekol inyan. Vekol zeh keshennahar o hammidron sheal sepato hu samuk mammash lammaboy. Abal im rachoq mimmennu beyoter meeser ammot — eno moil kelum (ella im ken yetaqqen sham betzurat happetach), shehare oto maqom hu kepirtza lemaboy zeh. Vaapillu eno rachoq mimmennu ella d' tepachim, im rabbim boqeim sham — asur, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"h bepirtzat maboy mitztziddo. (Vekol zeh kesheen hannahar maqqip kol hair. Abal im hu maqqip kol hair missabib — eno moil lah kelum, ella im ken yoshba velibsop huqqepa mimmennu, kemo sheyyitbaer):

Maboy shetztziddo echad arok vetziddo echad qatzar, apillu en tzad haarok odep al haqqatzar d' ammot keshiur maboy — eno manniach et haqqora al tzad haarok, ella keneged haqqatzar. Abal lo yannichenna baalakson ulehishtammesh betzad haarok ad haqqora, lepi shehaqqora hi mishshum hekker, ubaalakson en kan hekker, lepi sheharoeh bene hammaboy nimshakim umishtammeshim birshut harabbim o bekarmelit chutz mikkeneged kotel haqqatzar, omer: muttar lehishtammesh birshut harabbim o bekarmelit, lepi sheen oto haodep domeh sheyyehe min hammaboy. Abal im yirtzeh yaaseh sham tzurat happetach baalakson, vihe muttar lehishtammesh gam ken baalakson, baarok keneged haarok ubaqqatzar keneged haqqatzar. Abal im yaamid lechi echad etzel haarok velechi echad etzel haqqatzar — enan moilim lehishtammesh baalakson, sheap shehallechi eno mishshum hekker bilbad ella mishshum mechitztza, mikkol maqom lechi shebbetzad haarok eno moil lehattir lehishtammesh etzlo, hoil veen sham mechitztza kenegdo:

Lo ameru shehaqqora hammunnachat baalakson en bah hekker ella keshehi biqtzeh hammaboy shetztziddo echad arok vetziddo echad qatzar, umittaam shennitbaer, abal tok hammaboy yakol lehanniach haqqora baalakson ulehishtammesh baarok keneged haarok ubaqqatzar keneged haqqatzar:

Heemid lechi beemtza maboy, im min hallechi velachutz kelappe petach hammaboy yesh sham chatzerot petuchot lemaboy, veasu gam lechi lepetach hammaboy — en lechi happenimi moil lechalleq hammaboy shello yitztareku chatzerot hachitzonot vehappenimiyyot leareb yachad, kemo bishar meboot sheen lahem ella lechi echad lepitcham, shetztzerikim kol bene hammaboy leareb yachad, kemo sheyyitbaer. Velo ameru shellechi niddon mishshum mechitztza ella leinyan lehashlim hachissaron minyan hammechitztzot hatztzerikot lirshut hayyachid gemura, abal mikkol maqom enah mechitztza gemura sheyyukal lechalleq reshut achat lishtayim, shellazeh tzarik mechitztza gemura. Abal im lo asu hachitzonim lechi lepetach hammaboy — kevan shehem enam yekolim letaltel mechatzerotehem lammaboy apillu im yearebu, hare kemo sheen lahem cheleq kelal bammaboy beshabbat, veenam oserim al happenimi ap al pi shello erebu immahem, umuttarim happenimim lehishtammesh min hallechi velipnim im erebu benehem. Vehu sheyyehe beoto hachatzi hammaboy happenimi torat maboy, shello yehe orko pachot mid' ammot veyihyu battim vachatzerot petuchim letoko al derek shennitbaer. Veken haddin im hinnichu qora al emtza hammaboy. Abal im heemidu beemtza hammaboy shene passin shel b' mashshehuyin echad mitztzad zeh veechad mitztzad zeh o pas rachab d' tepachim mitztzad echad im en hammaboy rachab yoter meeser, o sheasu tzurat petach ap al pi sherachab yoter meeser — hare zo mechitztza gemura, umoelet lechalleq hammaboy shello yitztareku hachitzonim vehappenimim leareb yachad, ap al pi sheggam hachitzonim asu tiqqun lepetach hammaboy umuttarim letaltel bo im erebu benehem. Vaapillu hechatzer sheyyesh bah diyyurin harbeh yekolim lechalleqah beinyan zeh, shello yitztareku kullam leareb yachad ella ellu leatzman veellu leatzman. Veken ir hammuqqepet choma sherotzim lechalleqah o lehakshir chetzyah ulehanniach chetzyah — yitbaer besimman shtz"b:

Maboy shehu rachab k' amma, verotzeh lehakshiro belechi o qora — ketzad yaaseh? Oseh pas rachab d' ammot vegaboah y' tepachim umaamido beemtza happetach, rochbo leorko shel maboy, venechshab kol tzad mitztzidde happas kemaboy bipne atzmo kevan sheorko d' ammot keshiur maboy. Veyitten haqqora al rosh happas o tok g' tepachim, shehare pas zeh hu kotel hammeboot, vehaqqora shehi mupleget g' tepachim mikkotle hammaboy — pesula. Vetzarik sheyyihyeh bekol maboy mishshene (meboot) ellu shehappas mapsiq benehem battim vachatzerot petuchim letoko vekol tenae maboy shennitbaer lemala. Umin happas ad hakkotel emtzai shel hammaboy tzarik laasot sham tzurat happetach, apillu en sham yoter measara, lepi sheshsham mepullashim b' meboot ellu kol echad lachabero, upillush zeh dino kepillush lirshut harabbim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shs"d bemaboy aqom. Veyesh omerim sheen tzarik laasot sham tzurat happetach ella im ken yesh sham yoter measara. Veyesh lehachamir kisbara harishona:

Abal im yirtzeh lehaamid rochab happas lerochab hammaboy, ap al pi shennishar rochab hammaboy pachot measara harbeh mitztzad zeh upachot measara harbeh mitztzad zeh — eno moil kelum, lepi shehaavir shel rochab hammaboy shemmitztzad zeh umitztzad zeh mebattelim et happas shebbeemtzaam. Veella ketzad yaaseh? Yarchiq shene ammot mikkotel zeh, veyaamid sham pas rachab shelosha ammot vegaboah asara tepachim, veken yaaseh etzel kotel hashsheni, veyishshaer petach rachab y' ammot ben passim hallalu, sheaz en haavir shebben happassim im haavir shebben passim lakketalim baim umebattelim happassim shebbenehem, hoil vekol pas merubbeh al haavir shebbeno lakkotel sheetzlo. O yarchiq amma veyaaseh pas amma umechetza veyarchiq amma veyaaseh pas amma umechetza, veken yaaseh betzad hashsheni. O yarchiq b' ammot ub' tepachim veyaaseh pas b' ammot ved' tepachim, veken betzad hashsheni, veken kol kayyotze bazeh, ubilbad shehappas yehe yater al haavir shebbeno lakkotel sheetzlo, mittaam shennitbaer. Ulebad mippassim ellu tzarik laasot gam ken lechi lemaboy, shehappassim enam nechshabim lelechi, hoil vehem rechoqim mehakketalim g' tepachim. Vetzarik lizzaher shello yannichu bene hammaboy et petach haggadol shebben happassim shehallechi metuqqan bo, veyeleku lahem derek petach qatan shebben pas lakkotel, sheim ken nitbattel torat happetach min haggadol ubotla hallechi hammetuqqan bo, venimtza maboy zeh belo tiqqun, ella im ken yaaseh tzurat happetach lehaqqatan. Abal min hassetam en chosheshin shemma yannichu haggadol veyeleku baqqatan, shechazaqa en adam manniach petach gadol veniknas baqqatan:
Passim ellu enam tzerikin lihyot passim shelemim, ella sheyyehe kol echad asuy miqqanim — qaneh qaneh pachot mig' tepachim, shekkesatum veshalem hu mittorat labud:

Maboy sheshshaveh mittoko venaaseh midron biptichato lirshut harabbim, dehaynu sheqqarqa hammaboy gaboah mereshut harabbim vehutzrak leshappea etzel pitcho letzad reshut harabbim, o sheshshaveh lirshut harabbim venaaseh midron letoko, dehaynu sheqqarqa reshut harabbim gaboah miqqarqa hammaboy, utechillat kenisat hammaboy min happetach velipnim gam ken gaboah kirshut harabbim, veachar kak meshappea veyored letzad dopen haemtzai venaaseh midron — hare maboy zeh eno tzarik shum tiqqun bepitcho, lepi shettel zeh shebbepitcho nechshab lo limchitztza. Vehu sheyyihyeh beshippuo gaboah y' tepachim mitlaqqet mittok d' ammot, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h. Umikkol maqom, im rabbim boqeim alayv — asur (veap al pi shemmin hattora en beqiat rabbim mebattelet mimmennu shem hammechitztza, veillu haya [berochbo] d' al d' gebohim [y'] tepachim min haaretz mikkol tzedadehem hayeta sham reshut hayyachid gemura min hattora, vehazzoreq lesham mereshut harabbim chayyab — mikkol maqom middibre soperim asur letaltel kesherabbim boqeim sham, velaken en niddon gam ken mishshum mechitztza lemaboy middibre soperim. Umikkol maqom lo aseru chakamim ella bibqiat rabbim keen reshut harabbim. Abal kesheen rabbim boqeim kol kak betel zeh — muttar, velo gazeru bo mishshum tel sherabbim boqeim bo kemo sheggazeru bekol karmelit sheen rabbim boqeim bah mishshum reshut harabbim gemura sherabbim boqeim bah, lepi shekkol karmelit hi shello nigmeru minyan mechitztzoteha vedoma bemiqtzat lirshut harabbim, abal kan en shum dimyon kelal lirshut harabbim ella kesherabbim boqeim alayv bilbad. Ulehaomerim sheen beqiat harabbim chashuba laasot reshut harabbim ella im ken hem shishshim ribbo, kemo shennitbaer besimman shm"h — ap kan en beqiat harabbim mebattel mimmennu shem mechitztza (middibre soperim) ella im ken boqeim bo shishshim ribbo bekol yom):

(Vekol zeh keshehattel hu mechitztza rebiit lemaboy. Abal) im kol hair muqqepet tel, veheqqep zeh haya qodem binyan hair — en tel zeh oleh limchitztza limboot hair, lepi sheheqqep hattel lo huqqap ledira, kevan shehaya qodem binyan habbattim, veim ken kol hair hi yoshebet betok heqqep sheenah ledira, sheasur letaltel bo keshehu yoter mibbet satayim. Vekotle hachatzerot shennaasu achar binyan habbattim enam moilim ella laasot mah shebbetokam muqqap ledira, dehaynu hachatzerot atzman, abal hammeboot shebbahen enam niqraim muqqapim ledira al yede kotle hachatzerot shehem kotle hammaboy. (Sheeno domeh letel yoter mibbet satayim shello huqqap ledira veachar kak bana o patach lo bet dira veachar kak asa al gabbah mechitztza yoter meeser ammot ledira, sheal yede mechitztza zo naasa kullo muqqap ledira, kemo shennitbaer besimman shn"ch, lepi shemmechitztza zo asaah kede sheyyitbattel mimmennu heqqep harishon shello haya ledira, veal yede ken yeaseh muqqap ledira, kemo shennitbaer sham, abal kotle hachatzerot lo naasu bishbil sheyyihyu hammeboot muqqapim ledira veyitbattel mehem heqqep harishon shel hattel shello haya ledira. Velaken tzarik lebattelo al yede tzurat petach, shehi moelet laasot al yadah muqqap ledira kemo al yede mechitztza gemura, kemo shennitbaer sham ukemo sheyyitbaer besimman t"a. O apillu al yede pas d' o b' passin shel b' mashshehuyin, sheap shehem enam moilim laasot al yadam muqqap ledira, mikkol maqom hem moilim lachaloq reshuyyot kemo mechitztza gemura, kemo shennitbaer lemala, veim ken nechlaqim hammeboot meheqqep hattel al yede passim ellu, kemo shehem nechlaqim mimmennu illu hayu muqqapim mikkol tzedadehem bekotle chatzerot, ap al pi sheggam kotle hachatzerot enan moilot laasot hammeboot muqqapim ledira mittaam shennitbaer):

(Veken haddin benahar shemmaqqip kol hair qodem shennibnet). Vaapillu tel venahar sheenan maqqipim kol hair, enan olin ella limchitztza rebiit lemaboy sheeno mepullash. Abal maboy hammepullash mishshene rashayv lenahar o letel sheeno asuy bide adam — enan moilot lehattiro belo tiqqun beshum echad merashayv, lepi sheim hayu shishshim ribbo boqeim bemaboy zeh, haya reshut harabbim gemura, vekevan sheen lo ella b' mechitztzot mib' tzedadayv, shemmechitztzot hannahar mebattelet otan beqiat harabbim shebbammaboy, shehoil veenan asuyot bide adam enan chashubot mechitztza kol kak shello tebattel otan beqiat harabbim shebbammaboy. Sheap shebbimqoman hen mechitztza gemura, veen alehem din reshut harabbim ap im rabbim boqeim alehem kemo shennitbaer lemala, mikkol maqom enan chashubot kol kak lebattel hammaboy — sherabbim boqeim bo — middin reshut harabbim, veim ken ap im en rabbim boqeim bammaboy asur middibre soperim, gezera mishshum rabbim boqeim bo, kemo sheaseru kol karmelit sheen rabbim boqeim bah gezera mishshum reshut harabbim sherabbim boqeim bah. Abal mechitztza rebiit shel maboy — heqellu bah chakamim lihyot dayyah benahar vetel, kevan shebbimqoman hen mechitztzot gemurot, veenam geruim millechi kol shehu shemmoil beruach rebiit shel maboy mishshum mechitztza, shehare hallechi eno moil lachaloq reshuyyot kemo shennitbaer lemala, vehattel moil; vekevan shehu moil lachaloq reshut hammaboy mereshut harabbim shellepanayv — dayyo bekak, shehare haqqora enah moelet lammaboy ella mippene sheal yadah nikkar venireh shehammaboy chaluq mereshut harabbim shellepanayv, vekol shekken hattel shebbeemet hu choleq benehem:
